The only transition is \(\alpha+\beta=4/5\), with no logarithmic factor. An explicit four-fold midpoint spline contour rule attains the scalar-separated same-class converse in both asymmetric orderings. Public matrix and Bernstein tests, a total cell-pair fallback, certified root integration and an evaluated envelope produce a connected interval honest at every finite sample size.
